copy.tagline_en: Write tests for suite-common packages using Red-Green-Refactor workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain suite-common packages and need to follow TDD practices.

howto.what: 在编写 suite-common 包代码时，Claude 会遵循测试驱动开发流程：先写测试（红），再写实现代码（绿），最后重构（重构），并使用 @suite-common/test-utils 工具。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 suite-common 包编写测试或实现功能时触发，尤其是涉及 React hooks 的测试。

say.text: 帮我为这个函数写一个测试，遵循 TDD。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试，再写实现代码。

say.text: 用 @suite-common/test-utils 来测试这个 hook。
检查我的测试是否遵循了红绿重构循环。

howto.what_en: When writing code for suite-common packages, Claude follows TDD: write failing test first (Red), then minimal code to pass (Green), then refactor, using @suite-common/test-utils for hooks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to write tests or implement features for suite-common packages, especially for React hooks tests.

say_en.text: Write a test for this function following TDD.
say_en.note: Claude writes failing test first, then implements code.

say_en.text: Check my tests follow the Red-Green-Refactor cycle.
